title: Helpdesk Room Suggested
description: Creator-collab slice 6: room-suggest-skill produced a ranked list of candidate rooms for a persona + intent. Carries the parent intake_id (or 'explore' for ad-hoc), the persona context (agent_id + role), and the ranked candidates with persona-aware scores. Emitted by room-suggest-skill when invoked (ambient on every chat turn, or explicit on the room-suggest UI). Consumed by nats_event_bus + room-suggestions panel.

parent_intake_id.description: Optional parent intake_id (matches helpdesk.intake.opened.v1) when the suggestion was triggered by an intake

persona_role.description: Optional role hint used for persona-aware ranking (e.g. 'resident', 'creator', 'operator', 'elder')

intents.description: Intents extracted from the visitor's question or explicit 'next room' ask

hardware_needed.description: Optional hardware pin: gpu + min_vram_mb + node_roles. When set, candidates are filtered to rooms that satisfy the pin.

rationale.description: Why this room was ranked at this position (intent + persona + hardware match)

deep_link.description: Suggested deep-link into the candidate room's primary surface

directory_version.description: Version of the room directory snapshot used for the suggestion
